response.justification: Bogdan is a highly capable Staff Software Engineer with an impressive background in distributed systems, software architecture, and technical mentoring. However, he critically misses the minimum requirement of 8 years of C++ programming experience, having only about 7 months of professional C++ experience. Because this is a core requirement for the Technical Lead role on this specific compute platform, he is not a fit despite his strong overall engineering background.
strengths: Extensive experience building and scaling distributed systems and microservices handling high-throughput traffic.
Strong background in technical leadership, mentoring, and establishing engineering best practices like TDD and CI/CD.
Demonstrated ability to own end-to-end architecture, including founding an open-source Kubernetes-deployable platform.
concerns: Fails the minimum requirement of 8 years of C++ programming experience, possessing less than one year.
Primary tech stack heavily favors TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang over foundational compute and hardware infrastructure technologies.
Does not clearly demonstrate the preferred 2 years of experience specifically managing or mentoring dedicated cloud or DevOps engineers.
